svg.title: Second V4 checkpoint: narrow CFR development perplexity
svg.desc: Three observations on the same 7,057-label CFR development set. Stage-local completed valid labels: parent baseline 0, checkpoint 569 18,604,156, checkpoint 1,137 37,175,835. Perplexities respectively 39.776214231484126, 39.4729645509789, 38.51235059861212. Hollow circle is the repeated parent baseline, not a new checkpoint. The y-axis is restricted to show a small change. Repeated development evaluation is not sealed holdout or evidence of transferable logic.
